# Comfort Journey - Global Luxury Travel & Customized Holidays Worldwide

> Handcrafting personalized, comfortable vacations across 2,000+ destinations worldwide since 1992. Operating globally across all 7 continents with headquarters in Bhopal, India.

Comfort Journey is an established global travel management company and personalized luxury tour operator founded in 1992. We cater to international travelers and domestic travelers worldwide, providing end-to-end handcrafted private holidays with verified 4★ & 5★ hotels, dedicated private vehicles with professional local chauffeurs, international visa assistance, flight bookings, pre-arranged dietary preferences (including Pure Veg, Jain, Halal, and child-friendly dining), and 24/7 personal trip concierge support.

## International Travel Destinations (Worldwide Coverage)
Comfort Journey plans and operates private, fully customized holidays across all safe international travel destinations worldwide:

### 1. Europe & United Kingdom
- **Swiss Alps & Switzerland**: Zurich, Lucerne, Interlaken, Zermatt, Glacier Express, Mt. Titlis, and Jungfraujoch luxury chalets.
- **France & French Riviera**: Paris private Seine cruises, Eiffel Tower dining, Nice, Cannes, Monaco, and Provence lavender valleys.
- **Italy & Mediterranean**: Rome VIP Colosseum, Florence Renaissance art, Venice gondola charters, and Amalfi Coast cliffside villas.
- **United Kingdom & Scotland**: London private royal tours, Edinburgh Castle, Scottish Highlands, and Isle of Skye.
- **Spain & Portugal**: Barcelona (Sagrada Familia), Madrid, Seville flamenco private evenings, Lisbon, and Sintra palaces.
- **Greece & Aegean Islands**: Athens Acropolis, Santorini private sunset catamaran cruises, and Mykonos luxury beach resorts.
- **Nordic & Arctic**: Iceland Northern Lights & Golden Circle geysers, Norway Fjords, and Lapland glass igloo stays.
- **Central Europe**: Austria (Vienna & Salzburg), Germany (Bavaria & Black Forest), Czech Republic (Prague), and Hungary (Budapest).

### 2. Middle East & Arabian Gulf
- **Dubai & Abu Dhabi (UAE)**: Burj Khalifa At the Top VIP lounge, private desert dunes BBQ safari, Atlantis The Royal, and Museum of the Future.
- **Oman**: Muscat Sultan Qaboos Mosque, Wahiba Sands luxury bedouin glamping, and Jebel Akhdar mountain retreats.
- **Saudi Arabia**: AlUla ancient Nabataean ruins, Riyadh luxury culture, and pristine Red Sea private island resorts.
- **Egypt**: Cairo Pyramids & Sphinx, VIP Nile River 5-star luxury cruise from Luxor to Aswan, and Hurghada Red Sea diving.
- **Turkey**: Istanbul Bosphorus private yacht charter, Cappadocia hot air balloon & cave suites, and Pamukkale thermal terraces.
- **Jordan**: Ancient rose-red city of Petra, Wadi Rum luxury martian domes, and Dead Sea mineral resorts.

### 3. Southeast Asia & East Asia
- **Bali & Indonesia**: Private infinity pool villas in Ubud & Seminyak, Nusa Penida island speedboat tours, and Uluwatu sunset temple dance.
- **Thailand**: Phuket private yacht charters, Krabi four-island catamaran tours, Koh Samui luxury wellness, and Bangkok Michelin dining.
- **Singapore & Sentosa**: Marina Bay Sands, Gardens by the Bay, Universal Studios VIP passes, and Sentosa beachfront resorts.
- **Malaysia**: Kuala Lumpur Petronas Towers, Langkawi private geopark yachts, and Penang culinary food heritage.
- **Vietnam & Cambodia**: Hanoi Old Quarter, Halong Bay overnight luxury cruise, Da Nang Golden Bridge, and Siem Reap Angkor Wat sunrise.
- **Japan**: Tokyo luxury metropolis, Kyoto bamboo groves & geisha districts, Mt. Fuji private tours, and Cherry Blossom (Sakura) seasonal tours.
- **South Korea**: Seoul Gangnam culture, royal palaces, Nami Island scenic walks, and Jeju Island volcanic nature.

### 4. Indian Ocean & Tropical Island Getaways
- **Maldives**: Private overwater villas with slide & glass floors, private seaplane transfers, and all-inclusive sunset dining.
- **Mauritius**: Belle Mare private coral beaches, Ile aux Cerfs catamaran sailing, and Chamarel seven-colored earth.
- **Seychelles**: Mahe granite boulders, Praslin Anse Lazio beach, and La Digue bicycle island explorations.
- **Sri Lanka**: Bentota beach stays, Galle Dutch Fort heritage, Nuwara Eliya tea plantations, and Sigiriya Lion Rock.
- **Fiji & South Pacific**: Private lagoon bungalows and coral reef diving retreats.

### 5. Americas, Australia & African Wildlife Safaris
- **Kenya & Tanzania**: Serengeti & Masai Mara Great Migration private 4x4 safaris, Ngorongoro Crater, and luxury safari lodges.
- **South Africa**: Cape Town Table Mountain, Cape Peninsula scenic drive, Franschhoek wine tram, and Kruger National Park private Big 5 safaris.
- **United States & Canada**: New York City, California Pacific Coast Highway, Grand Canyon helicopter tours, Canadian Rocky Mountains, and Banff.
- **Australia & New Zealand**: Sydney Opera House private harbour cruise, Great Barrier Reef helicopter tours, Melbourne Great Ocean Road, and Queenstown fiordland adventures.

### 6. Worldwide Luxury Ocean & River Cruises
- Mediterranean luxury cruises, Alaskan Glacier Bay cruises, Norwegian Fjord cruises, Nile River cruises, and Rhine River European cruises.

## Signature Domestic Tour Packages (India)
- [A Symphony of Kashmir](https://www.comfortjourneyy.com/tour/a-symphony-of-kashmir/): 5-6 Days. Srinagar luxury Dal Lake houseboat, Gulmarg Gondola phase 1 & 2, Pahalgam Betaab Valley, and private chauffeur.
- [Rajasthan Royal Escape](https://www.comfortjourneyy.com/tour/rajasthan-royal-escape-where-history-meets-luxury/): 7-9 Days. Jaipur Amber Fort, Jodhpur Umaid Bhawan, Udaipur Lake Pichola private boat cruise, and royal heritage stays.
- [Leh Unveiled - High Altitude Stories](https://www.comfortjourneyy.com/tour/leh-unveiled-the-high-altitude-stories/): 6-8 Days. Pangong Tso luxury camps, Nubra Valley sand dunes, Khardung La pass, and oxygen-equipped private vehicles.
- [Andaman Getaway - Indian Maldives Edition](https://www.comfortjourneyy.com/tour/andaman-getaway-the-indian-maldives-edition/): 5-7 Days. Havelock Radhanagar beach, private catamaran cruises, Neil Island coral reefs, and luxury beach resorts.
- [Ayodhya & Varanasi - A Journey Within](https://www.comfortjourneyy.com/tour/ayodhya-varanasi-a-journey-within/): 4-5 Days. Ram Mandir VIP darshan, Kashi Vishwanath corridor, private evening Ganga Aarti boat, and senior-friendly pacing.
- [The Madhya Pradesh Chapter (Bhopal, Ujjain, Indore)](https://www.comfortjourneyy.com/tour/the-madhya-pradesh-chapter-bhopal-ujjain-indore/): 5-6 Days. Mahakaleshwar Bhasma Aarti VIP assistance, Sanchi Stupa UNESCO site, Bhimbetka, and culinary food trails.
- [Timeless Karnataka - Coffee, Coasts & Culture](https://www.comfortjourneyy.com/tour/timeless-karnataka-coffee-coasts-culture/): 6-7 Days. Coorg private coffee estate plantations, Mysore Palace, and Kabini wildlife safari.
- [Nainital & Jim Corbett Wilderness](https://www.comfortjourneyy.com/tour/nainital-jim-corbett/): 4-5 Days. Naini Lake private boating and Jim Corbett open-top 4x4 Jeep tiger safari.
- [Goa Unplugged - Salt Air & Slow Days](https://www.comfortjourneyy.com/tour/goa-unplugged-salt-air-slow-days/): 4-5 Days. South Goa Portuguese heritage mansions, private sunset yacht cruise, and beachfront luxury villas.
- [Sacred Gujarat Journey](https://www.comfortjourneyy.com/tour/the-sacred-gujarat-journey/): 6-7 Days. Somnath Jyotirlinga, Dwarkadhish temple, Bet Dwarka boat, and Gir Lion Safari.

2. **Handpicked 4★ & 5★ Accommodations**: Pre-inspected hotels, pool villas, and luxury heritage resorts.
